description: This file implements the CyclicBuffer class, which manages a circular buffer with thread synchronization, reservation, and data read/write operations, within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A thread-safe circular buffer class supporting reservation, locking, and data operations, with platform-specific synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with file-backed storage, buffer size, and overwrite mode.

methods.name: ~CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Ensures the buffer is loaded and valid, reloading if necessary.

methods.name: AdminLock
methods.description: Locks the buffer's administrative mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: SignalLock
methods.description: Waits for a signal with a specified timeout, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available (empty implementation).

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Signals waiting agents to reevaluate buffer state.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Sets an alert and triggers reevaluation.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into provided memory, handling wrap-around.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from provided memory, handling wrap-around and reservations.

methods.name: AssureFreeSpace
methods.description: Ensures there is enough free space in the buffer for a write operation.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for future writing, with process-specific reservation tracking.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Provides a non-destructive read of data without advancing the buffer pointers.

methods.name: GetOverwriteSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data to overwrite, virtual for customization.

methods.name: GetReadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data to read, virtual for customization.
